Exploitability_explanation: Confirmed explicit call to vulnerable logic in fs/config/ui.go at line 257: 'password, err = Password(bits)'. This function generates random passwords for backends like 'crypt'. Assuming the version is vulnerable (using math/rand), this allows for the generation of weak credentials. All constraints are satisfied as this is an active code path in the interactive configuration wizard.

Confirmed explicit calls to vulnerable APIs in backend/local/metadata.go: os.Chown (line 131) and os.Chmod (line 151). These calls are made on local files when o.translatedLink is false (not a symlink according to rclone), which is vulnerable to symlink traversal if an attacker replaces the file with a symlink between the check and the call. This satisfies all constraints for local filesystem metadata application.
